subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJD-V6 across its S-Type X200, XF X250, XJ X350 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJD-V6 appears across three Jaguar model lines — S-Type, XF and XJ — with the XF being the most common application we work on.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing belt, bearings, gaskets, oil cooler seals, injector seals, and crankshaft oil seals as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The AJD-V6 has several documented wear patterns: crankshaft bearing failure (rapid wear of liners, up to wedge and crankshaft breakage), oil leaks through the heat exchanger, timing belt breakage (belt changes every 120,000 km; belt breakage will bend valves), Siemens fuel system with piezo injectors (troublesome), EGR valve and thermostat weak points, and crankshaft oil seal failures.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJD-V6 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJD-V6 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJD-V6 uses a timing belt, not a chain — the interval is critical, and belt breakage will bend valves. We inspect the timing belt thoroughly on every rebuild and replace it as part of our standard scope. The crankshaft bearing system is another area we pay close attention to, as rapid wear of liners can lead to wedge and crankshaft breakage. Oil cooler leaks through the heat exchanger and injector seal issues are also common — we address these as part of every strip-down.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing belt, bearings, gaskets, oil cooler seals, injector seals, crankshaft oil seals

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
